sorry_locations: roots_outside_unit_disk (Rouché application to count roots inside/outside disk)
sorry_details.sorry_reason: Mathlib does not have Rouché's theorem. The proven lemmas establish: (1) the Rouché condition |h(z)| ≤ 4 < 5 = |g(z)| on |z| = 1, and (2) p has no roots on |z| = 1. The missing step is Rouché's theorem itself: since |g| > |h| on |z| = 1, p = g + h has the same number of zeros inside {|z| < 1} as g = 5z³ (which has 3). Then 10 − 3 = 7 roots outside.

proven_lemmas: p_no_roots_on_circle (zero-sorry): no roots on |z|=1 via reverse triangle inequality
